step.label: Validate Bill of Materials Compliance
step.description: Ensure all product components meet engineering standards and regulatory requirements before manufacturing begins.
step.useCase: Product engineering team needs to verify that all materials and product items in the BOM conform to company standards and change control policies.

step.label: Evaluate Material Sourcing Options
step.description: Identify approved vendors and assess material availability for all components in the validated BOM.
step.useCase: Procurement must find reliable suppliers and alternative sources for each material to mitigate supply chain risk.

step.label: Calculate Material Cost Impact
step.description: Determine financial implications of material selections and invoice-based historical pricing metrics.
step.useCase: Finance and product managers need cost forecasts to evaluate profitability of the new product launch.

step.label: Negotiate and Finalize Vendor Contracts
step.description: Coordinate with selected vendors to establish purchase orders and contractual terms aligned with procurement strategy.
step.useCase: Procurement specialists need to manage multi-vendor negotiations and PO generation to secure favorable terms and delivery schedules.

step.label: Plan Manufacturing and Equipment Allocation
step.description: Verify manufacturing equipment readiness and schedule production capacity based on workforce availability and maintenance requirements.
step.useCase: Operations managers must confirm sufficient staffing and equipment availability for the production ramp-up timeline.

step.label: Manage Manufacturing Equipment Readiness
step.description: Conduct equipment service reviews, document any change requests, and resolve outstanding maintenance or configuration issues.
step.useCase: Manufacturing engineering must ensure all production equipment is operational and configured to support the new product specifications.

step.label: Process Initial Customer Orders
step.description: Activate order fulfillment workflows for early adopter customers and validate inventory allocation.
step.useCase: Sales and fulfillment teams need to process first-wave customer orders while ensuring accurate inventory tracking and delivery commitments.

step.label: Launch Product Marketing Campaign
step.description: Engage target customer accounts with campaign messaging and coordinate promotional activities across sales channels.
step.useCase: Marketing must activate customer communications and drive awareness among key accounts to maximize product launch impact.
